free_tier.stated: No published total quota; per-post caps only. Effectively unlimited posts.

egress.terms: Free viewing, but images are re-encoded and served via i.pximg.net with a Referer check that blocks hotlinking from other origins. Not a usable direct-link CDN.

tooling: No official public upload API. pixivpy works for read; upload requires session-cookie replay and 2FA-prone flows.
chaining: Unlimited accounts x unlimited posts x 32 MB. The 32 MB per-illustration cap is generous for an image host.
limits_note: 32 MB per illustration post, 5 MB profile image; manga 32 MB/image and 30 MB per post total. Region-locked (JP login often required).
reliability_note: Referer-gated CDN means links are not freely hotlinkable, and re-encode is standard. Fails direct-link permanence.

evidence.proved: 'Profile images are limited to 5 MB per image. Illustration posts can be a maximum of 32 MB.'

notes: No published total quota; per-post caps only. Effectively unlimited posts.
